title: Fixed-universe derived localizations and adjunction for open restriction
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with derived localizations [def-pc-derived-category] for structure-sheaf modules on $X$ and on every localized open site, all with morphism universe $w$. For any open $U$, there are derived localizations, in the same universe $w$, for modules on the open subscheme $U$ and on each of its localized open sites. There is also a right adjoint $R$ to the exact derived localized restriction $L=D(\operatorname{overFunctor}_U)$, with an adjunction $L\dashv R$. These assertions hold without compactness or support hypotheses.

proof.text: Apply the proved upstream nonempty_hasDerivedCategory_openSubscheme X U. Its proof transports local w-smallness along the exact module equivalence Modules.overEquiv U and then uses hasLocalizationOfLocallySmall. Install the resulting localization hD on U.

Apply the proved nonempty_derivedOpenLocalization to U.toScheme with hD, obtaining hO in the same morphism universe w, and install it. This retains the exact extension-by-zero and restriction argument of lem-pc-derived-open-localization-universe.

Apply the proved upstream open_derived_localization_adjunction X U, which needs only the ambient and localized-over-U derived localizations already assumed. Its proof installs the Grothendieck abelian structure and K-injective resolutions and derives the underived right adjoint using mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction. Package this adjunction with hD and hO into the displayed nested existentials. The combined theorem has the distinct name open_derived_localizations_and_adjunction, avoiding collision with the upstream adjunction-only theorem.

theorem open_derived_localizations_and_adjunction
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (U : X.Opens) :
    ∃ hD : HasDerivedCategory.{w}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)),
    letI := hD
    ∃ hO : ∀ W : U.toScheme.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over W)),
    letI := hO
    ∃ (R : DerivedCategory
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ⥤
        schemeDerivedCategory X),
      Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
        (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ R)
